channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Centrão rejeita Zema como vice de Flávio e vê fala sobre Nordeste como "bomba eleitoral"
item.description: Centrão leaders reject Romeu Zema as a potential running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro, calling his remarks about the Northeast a 'disaster' and an 'electoral bomb' that opponents, especially Lula's government, could exploit. Despite the bloc's preference for Tereza Cristina, Zema remains the favored choice of Flávio Bolsonaro's hard core, with the two sharing an ironic joint video on social media after a technical tie in a Datafolha poll.

item.title: Neta de Lula ironiza Flávio Bolsonaro com dança da rachadinha
item.description: Lula's granddaughter, Bia Lula, posted an AI-generated Instagram video mocking Flávio Bolsonaro with the 'rachadinha dance,' referencing the salary kickback scheme investigated when he was a state deputy in RJ. The video responds to Flávio's use of dance in pre-campaign events, a tactic the PT is using to undermine his image. Flávio is in a technical tie with Lula in 2026 polls, with 45.8% versus 45.5% in a potential runoff.

item.title: Fim do mistério: quem deu a paca para Lula e Janja
item.description: O Globo reported that businessman Emílio Odebrecht, a longtime friend of Lula, was responsible for giving paca meat to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and his wife Janja. Odebrecht claims to be Brazil’s largest paca breeder and regularly gifts the meat to the presidential couple. The report resolves the mystery surrounding the origin of the meat served at a recent event.

item.title: TSE retoma julgamento de ex-governador de Roraima depois de cinco meses
item.description: The TSE will resume on Tuesday the trial of an action against former Roraima governor Antonio Denarium and current governor Edilson Damião, which had been suspended since November 2023 after Minister Nunes Marques requested a view. During the interval, Denarium left office to run for election and Damião, then vice-governor, assumed the position. Two votes have already been cast in favor of cassation for both; if a majority upholds this, Damião would lose office and Denarium would become ineligible. Both were removed by the Roraima TRE for improper use of public machinery during the electoral period and appealed to the TSE.

item.title: 83,8% dos eleitores do Paraná aprovam o governo Ratinho Junior
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey released on April 13, 2026 shows that 83.8% of Paraná voters approve of Governor Ratinho Junior’s (PSD) administration, with 34% rating it as excellent and 38.3% as good. The poll interviewed 1,500 people across 56 municipalities from April 10–12, 2026, with a margin of error of ±2.6 percentage points and 95% confidence level, registered with the TSE under PR-06559/2026 and funded by the Liberal Party (PL).

item.title: Moro lidera com folga a disputa ao governo do PR, diz pesquisa
item.description: Sergio Moro leads the race for governor of Paraná with between 46% and 52.5% of voting intentions, according to a Paraná Pesquisas survey released on April 13, 2026. The poll, conducted between April 10 and 12 with 1,500 voters across 56 municipalities, has a margin of error of 2.6 percentage points and a 95% confidence level. The study was funded by the PL and registered with the TSE under number PR-06559/2026.

item.title: STF tem ar de guerra aberta, irritação de Carmem e divergências explícitas
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court is experiencing heightened tension, with explicit divisions among ministers and visible irritation from Minister Carmen Lúcia during the ruling on the format of the new Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election. Court President Edson Fachin strives to maintain balance amid a tacit conflict between factions of the Court.

item.title: PSD nasce de ruptura com o DEM e vira força regional em 13 anos
item.description: The Social Democratic Party (PSD) was founded on April 13, 2011, by Gilberto Kassab after his departure from the DEM, aiming to occupy a centrist space in Brazil's polarized politics. Initially comprising 55 federal deputies, 2 senators, and 2 governors, the party attracted figures from multiple parties and consolidated as a regional force, celebrating its 13th anniversary in 2026 with a trajectory marked by pragmatism and alliances with governments of diverse ideologies.

item.title: Juro alto é o preço de um desequilíbrio fiscal desde 2014, diz Bentes
item.description: Fabio Bentes, chief economist at CNC, argues that record household indebtedness in Brazil stems from a fiscal imbalance since 2014, worsened by years of monetary tightening. He states that elevated interest rates are the price of this imbalance, with household debt reaching 80.4% in March — the highest in the historical series — and delinquency at 29.6%, up 1.0 percentage point year-on-year. The Lula government plans to release up to R$ 7 billion from FGTS and is studying a new Desenrola Brasil program to ease household debt.

item.title: Relatório de trabalho por apps reduz regras; governo cobra proteção
item.description: The PLP 152/2025 opinion reduces regulations for app-based work, maintaining autonomous status and setting a R$ 8.50 per ride floor, sparking conflict with the Lula government, which demands higher pay and stronger social protections, including night/weekend premiums and broader accident coverage. The text caps platform fees at 30% and lowers social security contributions, criticized by the Executive for weakening collective bargaining and worker safeguards.

item.title: Para Kassab, Leite será presidente, mas Caiado é escolha certa agora
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, defended the choice of Ronaldo Caiado as the party’s 2026 presidential pre-candidate, acknowledging Eduardo Leite’s dissatisfaction but asserting the decision was correct to advance in the center-right field. Leite lamented the choice but met with Caiado to focus on convergences, though he reiterated his disagreement over amnesty for January 8 defendants. Kassab said Leite still has a political future and will one day become president due to his age and dedication to public life.

item.title: Mandato de governador interino do Rio caminha para ser prorrogado
item.description: The mandate of Rio de Janeiro's interim governor, Ricardo Couto, is expected to be extended by the STF, potentially allowing him to remain in office until the October 2026 elections. The decision hinges on a ruling from the Supreme Federal Court, which is reviewing the continuity of the interim administration following the departure of the titular governor. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: PT quer aliança com PSDB para fortalecer disputa pelo governo de São Paulo
item.description: The PT is seeking an alliance with the PSDB to strengthen Fernando Haddad's gubernatorial ticket in São Paulo for 2026, engaging with pre-candidate Paulo Serra and probing Simone Tebet's potential party switch, which ultimately led her to join the PSB. While PT supporters view the move as key to building a broad front, PSDB figures remain skeptical, favoring an independent candidacy to maximize bargaining power in a potential runoff.

item.title: FGTS pode ser sacado na demissão e em mais 15 situações; veja quais e o que o governo quer fazer
item.description: The Lula government is planning to authorize an extraordinary FGTS withdrawal to help families pay off debts, releasing 20% of the balance for those earning up to five minimum wages. The measure is under study and aims to support financially vulnerable workers.

item.title: PT pede que TSE puna o TikTok por vídeos com “violência política”
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV, and PC do B) filed a representation with the TSE demanding TikTok be held accountable for AI-generated videos depicting political and gender-based violence against women wearing PT clothing. The coalition seeks user data from the RehVerse IA profile (over 400k followers), content removal, and a preliminary injunction to stop similar content across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and Kwai. Although the account was removed by 4:20 a.m. on April 13, 2026, the parties insist the TSE notify platforms to prevent further dissemination.

item.title: Quem é o delegado da PF detido após tentar furtar iguaria de luxo em shopping e que isentou Flávio Bolsonaro de acusações em 2020
item.description: Federal Police delegate Erick Blatt was detained in Recife after being caught on camera attempting to steal a jar of luxury truffle carpaccio valued at R$ 300 from a supermarket in Shopping RioMar. He was stopped by security, the item was recovered, and he provided statements to civil police, who opened an investigation. Blatt is known for having cleared Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in 2020 of ideological falsehood allegations and for his long-standing ties to the Bolsonaro family, including advocating for police autonomy in 2016.

item.title: Por Jorge Messias no STF, governo negocia cargos em agências para grupo de Alcolumbre e partidos de centro
item.description: The Lula government is negotiating regulatory agency positions with Davi Alcolumbre's group and Centrão parties to secure votes for Jorge Messias' STF nomination, following months of Senate resistance. The strategy involves splitting appointments between lawmakers and the Executive, respecting the origin of previous officeholders, as Lula aims to reverse the dominance of Bolsonaro-era appointees in these bodies.

item.title: Empate em pesquisa acirra ataques entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro em busca de eleitor fora da polarização
item.description: A tie between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in the runoff, according to a Datafolha poll, is intensifying the battle for voters who identify as outside the political polarization. Both candidates face high rejection rates and are seeking to expand their base beyond traditional ideological blocs.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE elege novo comando nesta semana; entenda as funções e como funciona
item.description: The TSE will elect its new president on Tuesday (14), with Minister Cármen Lúcia anticipating her departure. Under the rotation system, Nunes Marques is expected to assume the presidency and André Mendonça the vice-presidency. The election initiates the management transition, with inauguration scheduled by the end of May, brought forward due to Cármen Lúcia's commitments at the STF.

item.title: Un niño por mes es asesinado por su padre en Argentina, pero nadie habla de violencia vicaria
item.description: One boy is killed per month by his own father in Argentina in cases of vicarious violence, yet the issue receives little public attention. The content also notes Argentine writer Samanta Schweblin winning the million-euro Aena Narrative Prize, and highlights that Brazil may face presidential elections without female candidates for the first time in over 20 years. Additional topics include Christina Koch, the first woman to orbit the Moon, and a segment on heartbreak in Rosalía’s confessional.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado e suas chances na corrida presidencial - O Assunto #1699
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, aged 76, seeks his first viable presidential candidacy after over 30 years in Goiás politics and a recent shift to the PSD, aiming to win the party's internal primaries. His goal is to break political polarization and reach double digits in voter intention polls to establish himself as a national figure, despite his poor electoral performance in 1989.

item.title: Cláusula de barreira reforça depuração partidária
item.description: The party-switching window, which closed at the beginning of the month, saw around 120 deputies change parties, reflecting a more coherent consolidation of Brazil's party spectrum. The electoral threshold, or 'barreira de desempenho,' will require parties to obtain 2.5% of the national vote and at least 1% in nine federal units to retain access to public funding and free airtime in the 2026 elections. Combined with the end of proportional representation coalitions, this rule is contributing to the purification of the party system, with the threshold set to rise to 3% by 2030.

item.title: Não pode, companheiro Alexandre
item.description: President Lula gave two pieces of advice to Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, whom he referred to as 'companheiro'. The first was direct: Moraes should not participate in judgments related to the Master case. The second was indirect, suggesting changes to the STF, with full content available only to subscribers.

item.title: Geração atual não se identifica com referências políticas consagradas
item.description: The AtlasIntel-Bloomberg poll shows 72% disapproval of President Lula among Brazilians aged 16 to 24, a figure that transcends mere fluctuation or social media humor. This reflects a deeper symbolic and affective detachment of this generation from established political references. Full access to the article requires a subscription, restricting public analysis to the excerpts made available.

item.title: Acórdão de TSE sobre Castro deve ser publicado e destravar julgamento no STF sobre formato de eleição para mandato-tampão no Rio
item.description: The TSE is set to publish the ruling that convicted former Rio governor Cláudio Castro of abuse of political and economic power, which should unblock the STF’s deliberation on whether the interim gubernatorial election in Rio will be direct or indirect. So far, four justices favor an indirect election (Fux, Mendonça, Nunes Marques, and Cármen Lúcia), while one (Zanin) supports a direct vote, with Flávio Dino having requested a view pending the TSE’s official document.

item.title: Câmara se prepara para eleição ao TCU que vai testar força de Motta e realiza sabatina dos candidatos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies is holding hearings for seven parliamentarians nominated for a vacancy at the TCU, with a plenary vote scheduled for Tuesday. The decision tests the political strength of Chamber President Hugo Motta, who backs Odair Cunha (PT-MG) under a 2024 agreement with the PT. Although initially divided, the opposition ultimately rallied behind Soraya Santos (PL-RJ) following pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro to increase female representation on the court.

item.title: Governo vai travar alta de gastos com pessoal e novos benefícios tributários em 2027
item.description: The Lula government plans to implement in 2027 a cap on the growth of personnel spending and the creation of new tax benefits, aiming to control fiscal expansion in the first year of the next presidential term. The measure seeks to curb inflationary pressures and ensure the sustainability of public finances amid structural challenges.

item.title: Caiado deixa cargo em Goiás com ao menos 10 parentes no governo
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) left office on October 31, but at least 10 of his relatives remain in commissioned positions within the state government. The situation raises concerns about nepotism and the use of public resources to benefit family members, even after his departure from power. The case has sparked debate over transparency and ethics in Goiás public administration.

item.title: Ditadura fez dossiê sobre 'familiocracia' dos Caiado no Governo de Goiás
item.description: In the 1970s, Brazilian military dictatorship agents prepared a dossier to investigate the hiring of relatives by Leonino Caiado, then governor of Goiás, a practice termed 'familiocracy'. The document highlights nepotism in the state public administration, linking it to the cousin of Ronaldo Caiado, PSD's pre-candidate for president in 2026. The revelation emerges amid historical debate over clientelistic practices in Goiás politics.

item.title: Até agora, nada vincula Lulinha a desvios de recursos do INSS, diz presidente do PT
item.description: The national president of the PT, Edinho Silva, stated that there is no evidence linking Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) to the misappropriation of INSS funds, despite investigations and authorized bank and tax data breaches. He emphasized that President Lula requested the investigation and that Lulinha is being unfairly targeted solely due to his familial relationship with the president.

item.title: TCU, Eduardo Bolsonaro, escala 6x1 e nova chefia no TSE agitam a semana
item.description: The week in Brasília will be marked by hearings in the Finance and Taxation Committee of seven deputies competing for a vacancy at the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU), with names later submitted to a plenary vote. Also on the agenda are debates over the 6x1 work schedule and new leadership at the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), alongside Eduardo Bolsonaro’s activities in congressional committees.

item.title: E se Lula não for candidato nas eleições de 2026?
item.description: The possibility of Lula not being a candidate in the 2026 elections has gained traction due to declining government popularity and rising opposition support for Flávio Bolsonaro, despite PT members denying such a scenario. Lula stated he has not yet decided but will likely run, aiming for a fourth term. If he steps down, potential replacements include Geraldo Alckmin, who could run for São Paulo governor, or Camilo Santana, seen as a contender for the Ceará governorship.

item.title: Flávio usa vídeo de fome da época do governo Bolsonaro para atacar Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used a 2021 video, recorded during his father's government, to criticize Lula, showing scenes of hunger in Fortaleza. UOL verified the footage was from the Bolsonaro administration, when Brazil returned to the Hunger Map with over 33 million people facing food insecurity. Despite the temporal distortion, the video was used to attack Lula, while the candidates remain technically tied according to Datafolha.

item.title: No Rio de Janeiro, Botafogo empata com o Coritiba pelo Brasileirão 2026
item.description: Botafogo drew 2-2 with Coritiba at Estádio Nilton Santos in the 11th round of the 2026 Brasileirão, after leading through goals by Danilo and Arthur Cabral, only to concede a late equalizer due to a mistake by Villalba. Coach Franclim Carvalho was jeered and called an 'idiot' by fans at halftime, facing mounting pressure after another draw in the Sudamericana. The result leaves Botafogo in 11th with 13 points, while Coritiba rises to 7th with 16.

item.title: 'Foto' do Datafolha é ruim para Lula, mas o 'filme' é muito pior
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva acknowledged that the latest Datafolha poll is unfavorable to Lula, noting it is merely a snapshot of the moment. However, he warned that the recent sequence of polls reveals not an isolated photo but a corrosive film for the president, indicating a prolonged negative trend.

item.title: Fernando Morais recebe convidados em lançamento de 'Lula - Volume 2'
item.description: Writer Fernando Morais launched the second volume of his biographical trilogy on President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at an event held at Livraria da Vila in Brasília on Tuesday (7). The launch gathered guests and emphasized the continuation of the work that portrays the president's political and personal trajectory.

item.title: A recomendação do presidente do PT a Moraes sobre o Caso Master
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva endorsed Lula’s recommendation that Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes recuse himself from any judgment related to the Banco Master case involving Daniel Vorcaro, arguing it would preserve Moraes’s democratic legacy built after the January 8, 2023, coup attempt. Lula said he told Moraes not to let the Vorcaro case ruin his historical biography. Moraes faces pressure over alleged ties to Vorcaro and the Banco Master’s multimillion-dollar contract with his wife’s law firm.

item.title: Prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro é defendida por 59%, diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 59% of Brazilians believe Jair Bolsonaro should serve his sentence under house arrest, while 37% say he should return to prison and 5% were undecided. The survey, conducted April 7–9 with 2,004 respondents across 137 municipalities, has a margin of error of ±2 percentage points. Bolsonaro has been under humanitarian house arrest since March 27 following hospitalization for pneumonia, with the measure valid for 90 days and subject to judicial review by Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Flávio usa notícia sobre fome no governo Bolsonaro para criticar Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) used images of hunger recorded in 2021, during his father Jair Bolsonaro's government, to criticize President Lula in a video posted on April 12, 2026. The footage, originally published by Folha de S.Paulo, shows people collecting food from a garbage truck in Fortaleza. Minister Guilherme Boulos (Psol) criticized the decontextualized use of the material.

item.title: Encontrar uma liderança para substituir Lula 'não é simples', diz presidente do PT
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, stated that finding a leadership capable of replacing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the 2026 elections 'is not simple', given the current political landscape. The comment was made in an interview with Band's Canal Livre program, emphasizing the difficulties in building a viable alternative within the party.

item.title: Flávio usa vídeo feito durante governo Bolsonaro em crítica a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shared a video criticizing the Lula government, highlighting rising delinquency and hunger cases, including footage of families scavenging food from trash in Fortaleza. The material used was originally produced during the Bolsonaro administration, raising concerns about decontextualization. The post was made on Sunday, the 12th, as part of his pre-presidential campaign.

item.title: Maioria dos brasileiros defende prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro, segundo Datafolha
item.description: A majority of Brazilians (59%) support house arrest for Jair Bolsonaro, convicted of attempting a coup, while 37% believe he should serve time in Papuda prison. The Datafolha poll also shows Flávio Bolsonaro surpassing Lula for the first time in a potential runoff, though Lula remains ahead in first-round projections. Bolsonaro may serve 90 days under house arrest with an electronic bracelet and communication bans, subject to review by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Após apoio do PT a Juliana Brizola, Zucco lança pré-candidatura ao governo do RS em palanque com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Luciano Zucco (PL-RS) officially launched his pre-candidacy for governor of Rio Grande do Sul in an event featuring Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), strengthening alliances with PP, Novo, Podemos and Republicans. He labeled Gabriel Souza’s (MDB) ticket as an 'opportunistic centrão' and accused Eduardo Leite of shifting allegiance between Lula and Bolsonaro based on convenience. Former state deputy Juliana Brizola (PDT) was confirmed as the left’s candidate following internal PT deliberations.

item.title: Encontrar uma liderança para substituir Lula ‘não é simples’, diz presidente do PT
item.description: PT national president Edinho Silva stated that replacing Lula as a political leader is not simple, emphasizing his unique political capital and the difficulty of defining an immediate successor within the democratic field. He advocated for Lula's re-election in 2026 to ensure political and economic stability, warning that the risk of regression and authoritarianism would increase without his continuity. According to Edinho, new leadership will only emerge gradually through the consolidation of projects and connection with societal demands.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro critica Lula com vídeo sobre fome filmado durante o governo do pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) posted a video on social media criticizing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for alleged hunger in Brazil, using footage filmed in September 2021 during his father Jair Bolsonaro’s government. The video shows people scavenging for food in a supermarket dumpster truck in the upscale Cocó neighborhood of Fortaleza, Ceará, under the Bolsonaro administration. By pairing current news about the same issue with outdated footage from 2021, the senator unintentionally highlighted that food insecurity was already prevalent during his father’s presidency.

item.title: Lula paga o preço do desgaste que a política vive por causa da corrupção, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: The national president of the PT, Edinho Silva, said that President Lula's popularity is suffering due to the overall wear and tear of Brazilian politics caused by corruption cases, such as the Banco Master case, even without proven direct links to the president. The statement was made in an interview on Band's Canal Livre program.

item.title: A reforma necessária nas Forças Armadas em um 4º mandato de Lula, segundo José Dirceu
item.description: José Dirceu urges reform of the Armed Forces and Judiciary in a potential fourth Lula term, arguing military education promotes the 'internal enemy' ideology and Article 142 of the Constitution enables coup justifications, as seen in Bolsonaro’s 2022 aftermath. He links conservative military influence to evangelical churches replacing political parties in ideological diffusion. Reform must move beyond paper if Lula wins in 2026.

item.title: STF rejeita recurso da OAB e mantém indulto de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court rejected a petition from the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) and upheld the validity of the 2022 Christmas pardon issued by former President Jair Bolsonaro, which grants clemency to individuals convicted of crimes with a maximum penalty of up to five years. The decision was made by a majority on Saturday, November 11. The pardon remains in effect despite the OAB's challenge.

item.title: Lula paga o preço pelo desgaste que a política vive por causa da corrupção, diz presidente do PT
item.description: PT national president Edinho Silva says Lula's popularity is suffering from the political wear caused by corruption scandals, such as the Banco Master case, despite no proven direct link. He acknowledges the decline in Datafolha polls, with positive government ratings dropping from 32% to 29% between March and April 2026, and in the Northeast from 49% to 33% in February. Still, Edinho believes Lula's image will improve during the campaign as the public discerns actual responsibility in corruption.

item.title: Governo Lula faz evento para anunciar empréstimo ao túnel Santos-Guarujá
item.description: The Lula government last-minute invited members of Tarcísio de Freitas' administration to a ceremony signing a Banco do Brasil loan for the Santos-Guarujá tunnel construction. The event marks a new chapter in the dispute over the project's paternity, as the federal government seeks to associate itself with the initiative originally led by the São Paulo state administration.
